discussion_comments.comment_body: Feature-detect both _setUserInput and _clearUserInput, if absent, no-op the Tab handler.

Won't fix — the `\!== false` check is intentional for backward compatibility. Existing handlers (Codex, Kilo, etc.) return objects without a `success` field and have been working fine. Switching to `Boolean()` would break all of them. The inconsistent return shape across error paths is also pre-existing and not in scope here.
